given: stock records exist for one or more (sku, location) pairs
when: the operator opens the home screen
then: a single flat table lists one row per stock record showing that record's SKU, location, and quantity (all records, with no per-location navigation or filter)
architectural_notes: E2E: the home-screen table renders rows derived from a REAL server JSON response — the boundary (app/routes) exposes ONE unfiltered stock-list endpoint (no location route param / no per-location filter in S2), produced by app/services reading via app/repositories from the app/models stock_records entity. The React SPA renders a single FLAT global table, one row per (sku, location, quantity) across all records. Only a Playwright e2e against the live API verifies the SPA parses the actual response envelope and lists every record. No new persistence; reads the S1-established stock_records table.
